column1: # ---- RBAC: which table.column a role may read ------------------------
# keyMatch semantics: "inventory.*" matches any column of inventory;
# a bare "employees.name" is an exact match.
# hr_staff gets named columns only — salary is deliberately absent.
# The master relented: workers may read their OWN payslip. Salary lives in
# its own table (payroll) because p2 row filters are table-scoped — putting
# a self-only filter on `employees` would clamp ALL employees queries to
# one row. Every base role inherits `employee`.
# Managers additionally see their subordinates' payslips. Same-table row
# Applied by sql_gate.py as WHERE predicates ANDed into every SELECT that
# touches the table. {placeholders} are bound from the worker's attributes
# (worker_attributes.json) at query time. Missing attribute => deny.
# Multiple p2 rows for the SAME table are OR-combined (union of scopes).
